Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

headache — a pain in your head. Example: I have got a headache.
fever — a body temperature that is too high. Example: She has got a fever.
cough — a sudden noise from your chest when ill. Example: I have got a bad cough.
cold — with a low temperature. Example: It is cold today.
stomachache — a pain in your stomach. Example: I have got a stomachache.
pain — a feeling that something hurts. Example: The pain is bad.
ill — not well. Example: I am ill today.
symptom — a sign of illness. Example: What are your symptoms?
medicine — something you take when you are ill. Example: Take this medicine.
rest — to stop working and relax. Example: Rest for two days.
